name: labs/rk-exxec__pymupump
title: Harvard Apparatus Microliter OEM syringe pump (pymupump.Microliter)
intro: Harvard Apparatus Microliter OEM syringe pump (pymupump.Microliter), adapted from rk-exxec/pymupump. It sets `diameter`, `flowrate` and `targetvolume`; runs `pump` and `stop_pump`. `pump`: run a pump at a declared flow rate for a declared duration or volume in a declared direction, reporting the volume moved. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/rk-exxec__pymupump --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/rk-exxec__pymupump --backend fake --mcp
